title: docs(adr-0135): with SSO domain verification on, a provider creates an account only at a domain it has proven
body:
## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:更正 ADR-0135 中“域名验证”一段的设计描述:验证覆盖提供方列出的每个域名、改动域名列表会清除验证;并写明平台在新建账号处的规则:开启验证后,提供方只能为其已证明的域名下的邮箱新建账号,精确比较,失败即拒,任何受众姿态、邀请或 JIT 开关都不放宽,已有账号不复查。
- 为什么改:原文把保证写成“拒绝域名未证明的提供方登录”,没有说明新建账号必须落在已证明的域名上;代码修复在另一个 PR 中落地,设计文本须与之一致。
- 风险与回滚:仅文档,`docs/adr/**` 属 Tier H 受管面,不发布任何包;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0135-identity-and-access-architecture.md` 中 "Domain verification is opt-in" 一段(唯一改动)。
- 两分钟验证:打开本 PR 的 Files changed,读该段,预期它与代码 PR 的 changeset 所述规则一致。
- 需要你做的:作为 Tier H 受管面,审阅并批准(或亲手合并)本 PR。

## What changes

`docs/adr/0135-identity-and-access-architecture.md`, the "Domain verification is opt-in" paragraph, corrected to state what verification guarantees:

- the DNS-TXT proof covers every domain a provider lists, a provider signs nobody in until that list is proven, and editing the list clears the proof;
- where the platform admits a new account, a provider creates an account only for an email address at a domain it has proven, compared exactly (a subdomain counts only when it is itself listed and verified), failing closed, and relaxed by no audience posture, invitation or JIT toggle; accounts that already exist are not re-checked.

The code that holds the rule, its tests, the code comments and `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` land in the draft PR from `claude/sso-account-only-at-proven-domain`. This PR is split off because `docs/adr/**` is a Tier H governed surface, so the fix does not wait on this approval.

## Tests

None: documentation only.

## Acceptance notes

No decision is reversed: the paragraph keeps D6 opt-in and off by default, and states the guarantee the code now holds.
